title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Vannathi questions Chandayatha about the family's past conflicts, stirring even more trouble. When Pandian tries to stop Vannathi, Chozhan stands firmly by her side.

title: Azhagae Azhagu
description: Suresh misjudges a couple chatting on the roadside as lovers and warns them, sparking an argument with Mathi. Elsewhere, Thangaraj confronts Revathi for not showing him respect.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: Sethupathi changes his mind at the last moment while handing Azhagar over to Tamizhselvi. He insists she return home for the children's sake, not as his wife.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
episodeTitle: Madhu Bows to Her Father's Demand
description: Madhu's father locks himself in a room when she refuses to wear her wedding saree. Fearing his suicide threat, Madhu agrees to marry Shyam and prepares for the wedding.

title: Kanmani Anbudan
episodeTitle: Kanmani Makes Anbu Her Chief Guest
description: Kanmani's conscience encourages her to invite Anbu to her shop inauguration. She writes him a heartfelt letter expressing her gratitude and inviting him as the chief guest.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
episodeTitle: Abhi Finds a Way to Expose Indhira
description: Kandhasamy's family praises Murugan for the delicious reception feast. Abhi uncovers Indhira's deception before her wedding to Murugan and awaits a chance to expose her.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Sudar advises Thangamayil against taking hasty steps as she loses hope of reuniting with Saravanan. Ravi offers Senthil a way to regain his job using his father's influence.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Following the showroom's reopening, Manoj interviews candidates to select employees. Annamalai happily inaugurates the event business started by Meena, Rohini, and Shruthi.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Vetri buys new dresses for the family after receiving a Diwali bonus from his office. Accepting Mahesh's invitation, the family plans to celebrate Diwali at his home.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: Meenatchi attempts to save Senthamizh from Thennavan after spotting her at the hotel. Just as Thennavan and his friends attack Meenatchi, Azhagar takes on the goons.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Suspecting that Ayyappan is alive, Rishi checks hospitals for injured patients. Meanwhile, Ilamathi suddenly collapses on the road and is rushed for medical care.
